method: Locked external municipality validation of component_flow versus the 10-year exogenous net-migration baseline inside the full event-age aligned cohort model.

decisionRule.municipalityRobustness: At most one holdout municipality may have component-flow n+1 net-migration MAE more than 10% worse than net_10y.
decisionRule.note: Passing this gate is necessary but not sufficient for production promotion. No parameter or window may be retuned after viewing these holdout results and then re-evaluated on the same municipalities as independent evidence.

governance.note: These municipality results are independent holdout evidence only for the already-locked component_flow candidate. If parameters are changed after viewing this report, these municipalities may no longer be reused as independent confirmation.

1780.name: Karlstad
1780.rationale: Regional university centre outside northern Sweden; tests geographic transferability.

2380.name: Östersund
2380.rationale: Northern regional centre with a smaller population base than Luleå.

2480.name: Umeå
2480.rationale: Northern regional and university centre; tests a strong young-adult migration structure without using Luleå data.

2482.name: Skellefteå
2482.rationale: Northern industrial stress test with major structural change; tests robustness to non-stationary migration.

0780.name: Växjö
0780.rationale: Regional university centre in southern Sweden; adds a structurally different external holdout.
